name: Nook
tagline: Kitchen organizers made for small kitchens

products.name: Bamboo Drawer Organizer
products.short: Expandable tray that keeps spoons, knives and tools sorted.
products.description: An expandable bamboo tray that fits most kitchen drawers. Slide the sides out to fit a drawer from 30 cm to 45 cm wide, then sort cutlery and tools into five sections.
features: Five sections with a deep centre well

products.name: Tiered Spice Rack
products.short: Three tiers so every jar is visible at a glance.
products.description: A three-tier rack that turns one shelf into three. Each step sits higher than the one in front, so you can read every label without moving a jar.
features: Holds up to 18 standard spice jars

products.name: Cabinet Shelf Riser
products.short: Doubles the space inside any cabinet.
products.description: A sturdy riser that creates a second level inside a cabinet. Store plates on top, bowls or pans underneath, and reach everything without unstacking.

products.name: Airtight Jar Set (6 pcs)
products.short: Keeps rice, pulses and flour fresh and pest-free.
products.description: Six clear jars with airtight lids for dry goods. Stackable, easy to label, and sized for rice, daal, sugar, flour and tea.

products.name: Cutlery Tray XL
products.short: A wide tray for forks, spoons and long utensils.
products.description: A long, shallow tray with six slots, made for wide drawers. Fits long ladles and spatulas without bending them.

products.name: Hanging Mug Rack
products.short: Frees up shelf space by hanging mugs under a cabinet.
products.description: A slim rack that screws under a cabinet and holds six mugs. Clears a full shelf and keeps your favourite cups in reach.
